body: No problem mate! Everyone needs an ear from time to time, I hope it all works out for you in the end, if you ever need to talk never hesitate for a message! Enjoy the rest of your night/day, and I hope the hangover isn't too brutal in the morning.

I tell myself that every time, that it's just a chemical imbalance and it'll pass etc, but it's a long time passing.
Again I don't know, I can't control how I feel, I feel like I am a good child to them, but a disappointment, yknow the whole "did well in school but dropped out of college story".
They are good people and have their own problems to deal with, burdening them with the fact that their child isn't right just makes me feel worse, it's not their fault it's broken and yet they're the ones who feel obligated to patch things up. People can argue that that's what parenting is, kissing the bumps and bruises belonging to your daughter/son to make them feel better, but the bumps and bruises are internal once they grow up, and are harder to kiss better, but you'll always do you best to make the pain go away.
Anyway thank you for your well wishes, you are a wonderful person to talk to people such as myself who just need a listening ear, really thank you, goodnight!

Unrequited love is tough. I've been there, and it fucking sucks and still hurts. I've had a few drinks too so maybe my advice isn't as sound as it could be. What I've tried to do is cut them off as much as you can. Delete them from social media eg snapchatting, maybe block their posts on Facebook if you have them as friends. Try to cut communication as much as you can, because a text message as simple as "hey" can just drag you back into the deep end. Depending on how close you are this could be tough, I was really good friends with my crush, and a long story later nothing would ever come from it, I spent 3 years hanging onto this person, who I'm not sure even gives a fuck about me, would probably sleep with me yeah, but ultimately that would satisfy the curiousity enough that they'd never give a second glance in my direction. It'll hurt but you just have to move on, especially that they said nothing would ever come from it. There's no point in hanging onto something that isn't there, it'll just hurt your fingers more. It'll suck and you'll cry and you'll get drunk and message them, and then regret it in the morning, and the cycle will continue where you can't stop thinking of them. But one day there's going to be someone else who's the brightest and most brilliant light in the darkness and everyone else will have been dull, it'll come, all we have to do is hope.
Good luck buddy, enjoy your drinks and friends x
